title.rendered: Cardboard and Paper Upgrades – Purifying Fiber Lines

content.rendered: Retrofits that make a difference. Great Northern Fibers increased throughput while purifying their fiber products, enabling them to capitalize on rising OCC prices. Click here to discover more about VDRS’s systems for processing cardboard, paper and other types of commercial waste.
